answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using multi-environment telemetry proofs, requiring nodes to verify live signals from a distant nebula, a coastal reef, and an orchard. Because validation requires real-time data from dispersed instruments, an attacker must fund hardware fabrication and site leases per identity instead of cloning software processes. However, weather volatility and biofouling degrade sensor fidelity, occasionally locking out legitimate agents during calibration drift.
